description: Timed on-chain virtual-pet care game verified inside a Morpheus TEE. Pay a small GAS entry, choose a nursery path, then feed, play, pet, and rest your creature — each care action deterministically adjusts happiness, hunger, and energy inside the enclave. Raise happiness to the target before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Sprout Hatch (reach 50), 0.5 for Glow Garden (reach 70), 1 for Royal Bloom (reach 100). The enclave enforces real-time action spacing so a run cannot be bot-bursted. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上虚拟宠物养成游戏，在 Morpheus TEE 中验证。支付少量 GAS 报名费，选择育成路线，然后给你的宠物喂食、玩耍、抚摸和休息——每个照料动作都会在飞地内确定性地调整快乐值、饥饿值和精力值。在截止时间前将快乐值提升到目标即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：嫩芽孵化 0.1（达到 50）、荧光花园 0.5（达到 70）、皇家绽放 1（达到 100）。飞地强制照料动作之间的实时间隔，使脚本无法瞬间刷分。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The pet's starting stats are generated inside a Morpheus TEE enclave from a deterministic per-game secret, with only the hash commitment bound on-chain. Each care action's deltas are applied by the enclave, which enforces real-time spacing between actions (no super-human bursts) and replays the recorded action log at settlement to compute and sign the happiness reached after checking the commitment.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
